title: Qila olaman / qila olmayman
goal_uz: Dars oxirida can va can't bilan nimani qila olishingiz va qila olmasligingizni aytasiz, Can you ...? savolini berasiz va well, a little, not at all so‘zlari bilan darajani ifodalaysiz.

scenes.title: Nimalarni qila olasiz?
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n sakkizinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda sevimli mashg‘ulotlar va bo‘sh vaqt haqida gaplashdik. Bugun nimani qila olishingiz va nimani qila olmasligingiz haqida gapirishni o‘rganamiz. Bu mavzu ish suhbatida, yangi do‘st orttirganda va to‘garakka yozilganda kerak. Dars oxirida beshta qila oladigan va beshta qila olmaydigan ishingizni ingliz tilida ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson eighteen! Last time we talked about hobbies. Today we will learn to say what we can and can't do.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n sakkizinchi darsga xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar sevimli mashg‘ulotlar haqida gaplashdik. Bugun nimani qila olishimiz va olmasligimizni aytishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Can: qila olaman
board: She can cook.  (U ovqat pishira oladi.)
scenes.say_native: Biror ishni qila olishimizni “can” so‘zi bilan aytamiz. O‘zbekchada buni fe’lga qo‘shimcha qo‘shib hosil qilamiz: “suzmoq” bo‘lsa, “suza olaman”. Inglizchada esa “can” alohida so‘z, uning orqasidan fe’l o‘z holicha keladi: “I can swim”. “Can” ni modal fe’l deyiladi, ya’ni boshqa fe’lga qobiliyat, imkoniyat ma’nosini beradi. Formula: ega, can, fe’l.
scenes.say: Can means able to. I can swim. She can cook. We use can plus a verb.
scenes.say_uz: Can qila olish degani. Men suza olaman. U ovqat pishira oladi. Can va fe’l ishlatamiz.

scenes.title: Can hamma shaxsda bir xil
board: I can   you can   we can   they can
he can   she can   it can
scenes.say_native: Can ning ajoyib tomoni shundaki, u hamma shaxsda bir xil. “I can”, “you can”, “he can”, “she can”, “they can”. “Can” ga uchinchi shaxsda “s” qo‘shilmaydi. Ikkinchi qoida: undan keyingi fe’l o‘z asl shaklida turadi, “to” ham, “ing” ham yo‘q. Ya’ni “can” dan keyin faqat sodda fe’l: “swim”, “cook”, “dance”. Bu qoidalarni bilsangiz, can bilan yuzlab gap tuza olasiz.
scenes.say: I can, you can, he can, she can. No s. After can, use the simple verb. He can swim.
scenes.say_uz: I can, you can, he can, she can. S yo‘q. Can dan keyin sodda fe’l. U suza oladi.

scenes.title: Can bilan uch xato
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “He cans swim”. Hozirgi zamon qoidasi bo‘yicha “he” bilan “s” qo‘shishga o‘rganib qolgansiz, lekin “can” da u yo‘q. Ikkinchisi: “I can to swim”. O‘zbek tilida fe’l hamisha oxiriga qo‘shimcha oladi, shuning uchun ko‘pchilik “to” qo‘shib yuboradi. Uchinchisi: “I can swimming”. “Ing” bu yerda keraksiz. To‘g‘risi: “I can swim”, “he can swim”.
scenes.say: Not: he cans swim. Say: he can swim. Not: I can to swim. Not: I can swimming. Say: I can swim.
scenes.say_uz: He cans swim emas. He can swim deng. I can to swim emas. I can swimming emas. I can swim deng.

scenes.title: Ko‘nikma so‘zlari: harakat
board: ride a bike, ride a horse
scenes.say_native: Endi ko‘nikmalarni ifodalovchi so‘zlar. “Swim” — suzish, “run” — yugurish, “dance” — raqsga tushish, “sing” — qo‘shiq aytish. “Ride a bike” — velosiped haydash, “ride a horse” — ot minish. “Drive a car” — mashina haydash, bu yerda “drive” ishlatiladi, “ride” emas. “Cook” — ovqat pishirish. Musiqa asbobi bilan “play the piano”, o‘yin bilan “play chess”, ikkalasida ham “play”.
scenes.say: Swim, run, dance, sing. Ride a bike. Drive a car. Cook. Play the piano. Play chess.
scenes.say_uz: Suzish, yugurish, raqs, qo‘shiq. Velosiped haydash. Mashina haydash. Ovqat pishirish. Pianino chalish. Shaxmat o‘ynash.

scenes.title: Ko‘nikma so‘zlari: til va ish
scenes.say_native: Yana bir guruh ko‘nikmalar. Tillar bilan “speak”: “speak English”, “speak Russian”, “speak Uzbek”. Diqqat, inglizchada “speak in English” demaymiz, to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri “speak English”. “Write” — yozish, “read” — o‘qish, “type” — klaviaturada yozish, “use a computer” — kompyuterdan foydalanish, “draw” — rasm chizish. Bu iboralar ish e’lonlarida va o‘z-o‘zingizni tanishtirishda tez-tez uchraydi.
scenes.say: Speak English. Write. Read. Type. Use a computer. Draw. We say speak English, not speak in English.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida gapirish. Yozish. O‘qish. Terish. Kompyuterdan foydalanish. Rasm chizish. Speak English deymiz, speak in English emas.

scenes.title: Ali nimani qila oladi?
board: Ali: swim, cook, ride a bike
scenes.say_native: Ali haqida gapiring. Ali suza oladi, ovqat pishira oladi va velosiped haydaydi. Uchta to‘liq gap tuzing. Har birini “He can” bilan boshlang. Esda tuting: “can” ga “s” qo‘shilmaydi va “to” kerak emas. Birinchi: suzish. Ikkinchi: ovqat pishirish. Uchinchi: velosiped haydash.
scenes.say: Talk about Ali. He can swim, cook and ride a bike. Say three sentences. Start each one with he can.
scenes.say_uz: Ali haqida gapiring. U suza oladi, ovqat pishira oladi va velosiped haydaydi. Uchta gap ayting. Har birini he can bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “He can swim.” “He can cook.” “He can ride a bike.” Uchala gapda ham “can” o‘zgarmadi, fe’llar esa oddiy holda. Agar “cans” yoki “can to” deb aytsangiz, o‘sha uch xatoni yana bir bor eslang. Yaxshi tomoni shuki, “can” bilan faqat bir qoidani o‘rganasiz va uni barcha shaxslarda ishlatasiz.
scenes.say: He can swim. He can cook. He can ride a bike.
scenes.say_uz: U suza oladi. U ovqat pishira oladi. U velosiped haydaydi.

scenes.title: Can't: qila olmayman
scenes.say_native: Qila olmaslikni “can't” bilan aytamiz. Bu “cannot” ning qisqartmasi. “Cannot” bitta so‘z bo‘lib yoziladi, ikkiga bo‘lib “can not” deyish kam uchraydi. O‘zbekchada inkor fe’lga qo‘shiladi: “suza olmayman”. Inglizchada “can” dan keyin “not” keladi va odatda “can't” deymiz. Formula: ega, can't, fe’l. Yana bir marta: “don't” kerak emas, chunki “can't” o‘zi inkor shakli.
scenes.say: I can't swim. She can't drive. Can't is short for cannot.
scenes.say_uz: Men suza olmayman. U mashina haydamaydi. Can't - cannot ning qisqartmasi.

scenes.title: Can va can't talaffuzi
board: I can swim ≠ I can't swim
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz juda muhim, chunki “can” bilan “can't” ni adashtirish ma’noni teskari qiladi. Tasdiq gapda “can” yengil va qisqa aytiladi: “kən”, deyarli “kn”. Inkor gapda “can't” kuchli va cho‘ziq: “kaant”, ya’ni “a” uzun. Britaniya inglizchasida shunday. Amerika inglizchasida esa ikkalasi bir-biriga yaqin eshitiladi, “t” ko‘pincha yutiladi, shuning uchun kontekstga va gap ohangiga qarang.
scenes.say: I can swim, with a weak can. I can't swim, with a long strong can't. In American English the difference is smaller.
scenes.say_uz: I can swim, yengil can bilan. I can't swim, uzun va kuchli can't bilan. Amerika inglizchasida farq kichikroq.

scenes.title: Inkorda xato
scenes.say_native: Inkorda ikki xato bor. Birinchisi: “I don't can swim”. Hozirgi zamonda “don't” ishlatishga o‘rganib qolgan o‘quvchilar “can” bilan ham uni qo‘yadi. Lekin “can” o‘zi yordamchi fe’l, unga “do” kerak emas. Ikkinchisi: “I no can swim”, bu so‘zma-so‘z tarjima. Doim “can't” ishlating. Qoida oddiy: “can” bor joyda “do”, “does”, “don't”, “doesn't” bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: Not: I don't can swim. Not: I no can swim. Say: I can't swim. Can never needs do or does.
scenes.say_uz: I don't can swim emas. I no can swim emas. I can't swim deng. Can ga hech qachon do yoki does kerak emas.

scenes.title: Ali: ha va yo‘q
scenes.say_native: Jadvalga qarang. Ali suza oladi, lekin mashina haydamaydi. Ovqat pishira oladi, lekin qo‘shiq ayta olmaydi. To‘rtta gap tuzing: ikkitasi “He can”, ikkitasi “He can't”. Birinchi: suzish. Ikkinchi: mashina haydash. Uchinchi: ovqat pishirish. To‘rtinchi: qo‘shiq aytish. Gaplarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Look at Ali. He can swim and cook. He can't drive or sing. Make four sentences about Ali.
scenes.say_uz: Aliga qarang. U suza oladi va ovqat pishira oladi. U mashina haydamaydi va qo‘shiq ayta olmaydi. Ali haqida to‘rtta gap tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “He can swim.” “He can't drive.” “He can cook.” “He can't sing.” Tick belgisi bo‘lsa “can”, xoch belgisi bo‘lsa “can't”. Hammasida fe’l oddiy shaklda turibdi. Siz endi o‘zbekchadagi “-a olaman” va “-a olmayman” qo‘shimchalarini inglizchadagi “can” va “can't” bilan almashtirdingiz. Bu o‘tish ko‘pchilik uchun eng qiyin qadam edi.
scenes.say: He can swim. He can't drive. He can cook. He can't sing.
scenes.say_uz: U suza oladi. U mashina haydamaydi. U ovqat pishira oladi. U qo‘shiq ayta olmaydi.

scenes.title: Eshiting: can yoki can't
scenes.say_native: Endi quloq mashqi. Men uchta gap aytaman. Har birida “can” yoki “can't” bor. Yengil “kən” eshitsangiz, tasdiq, uzun “kaant” eshitsangiz, inkor. Qaysi biri ekanini aniqlang. Gaplar: birinchi, uchinchi shaxs, haydash. Ikkinchi, ovqat pishirish. Uchinchi, raqs. Eslab qoling, ohangga, ya’ni “a” ning uzunligiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Listen. One: he can drive. Two: she can't cook. Three: they can dance.
scenes.say_uz: Eshiting. Bir: u mashina haydashni biladi. Ikki: u ovqat pishira olmaydi. Uch: ular raqsga tusha oladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gap tasdiq: “He can drive”, yengil “can”. Ikkinchi gap inkor: “She can't cook”, uzun “can't”. Uchinchi tasdiq: “They can dance”. Agar adashgan bo‘lsangiz, tashvishlanmang, hatto ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham ba’zan telefonda adashadi. Shuning uchun yana bir muhim maslahat bor: inkorni aytganda ovozingizni biroz cho‘zing va aniq ayting.
scenes.say: He can drive. She can't cook. They can dance.
scenes.say_uz: U mashina haydashni biladi. U ovqat pishira olmaydi. Ular raqsga tusha oladi.

scenes.title: Savol: Can you...?
board: Yes, I can.  /  No, I can't.
Can he cook?  Yes, he can.
scenes.say_native: Savol tuzish juda oson: “can” ni gapning boshiga olib chiqamiz. “You can swim” bo‘lsa, “Can you swim?”. Yordamchi “do” kerak emas. Javob ham qisqa: “Yes, I can” yoki “No, I can't”. Savolda ham, javobda ham fe’lni takrorlamaymiz. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “suza olasizmi?” savoliga qaraganda ancha oson, chunki faqat so‘z tartibi o‘zgaradi, qo‘shimcha kerak emas.
scenes.say: Can you swim? Yes, I can. No, I can't. Can he cook? Yes, he can.
scenes.say_uz: Siz suza olasizmi? Ha. Yo‘q. U ovqat pishira oladimi? Ha.

scenes.title: Savolda xato
board: ✓ Can you swim? Yes, I can.
scenes.say_native: Savolda ham uchta xato. Birinchisi: “Do you can swim?”. “Can” bilan “do” ishlatilmaydi. Ikkinchisi: “Can you to swim?”, “to” yana ortiqcha. Uchinchisi: javobda “Yes, I do” deyish. Savolda “can” bor ekan, javobda ham “can” bo‘lishi kerak: “Yes, I can”. Qoida: savolda qaysi yordamchi so‘z bo‘lsa, qisqa javobda ham o‘sha takrorlanadi.
scenes.say: Not: do you can swim. Say: can you swim? Answer with can: yes, I can.
scenes.say_uz: Do you can swim emas. Can you swim deng. Javobda ham can: yes, I can.

scenes.title: What can you do? va iltimos
board: What can you do?  (Siz nima qila olasiz?)
Can you help me?  (Menga yordam bera olasizmi?)
Can I open the window?  (Derazani ochsam bo‘ladimi?)
scenes.say_native: Savol so‘zi bilan ham so‘rash mumkin: “What can you do?”, “What can you cook?”. Savol so‘zi boshida, keyin “can”, keyin ega. “Can” ning yana bir muhim vazifasi bor: iltimos va ruxsat so‘rash. “Can you help me?” — yordam bera olasizmi? “Can I open the window?” — derazani ochsam bo‘ladimi? Javob odatda “Sure” yoki “Of course”, yoki “Sorry, I can't”.
scenes.say: What can you do? Can you help me? Can I open the window? Sure! Sorry, I can't.
scenes.say_uz: Siz nima qila olasiz? Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Derazani ochsam bo‘ladimi? Albatta! Kechirasiz, bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Savol tuzing
board: 2) Ask a friend: ride a bike?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol tuzing. Birinchi: Anna suza oladimi? Ikkinchi: do‘stingizdan velosiped haydashni bilishini so‘rang. Uchinchi: do‘stingizdan nima pishira olishini so‘rang. Birinchi va ikkinchisida “can” gapning boshida, uchinchisida avval “what”. Savollarni to‘liq baland ovozda ayting va “do” ishlatmang.
scenes.say: Make three questions. One: Anna, swim. Two: ask a friend about riding a bike. Three: ask a friend what he can cook.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol tuzing. Bir: Anna, suzish. Ikki: do‘stingizdan velosiped haqida so‘rang. Uch: nima pishira olishini so‘rang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “Can Anna swim?” “Can you ride a bike?” “What can you cook?”. Uchala savolda ham “do” yo‘q va fe’l sodda holda. Hozir siz javob berishni ham, savol berishni ham bilasiz, ya’ni to‘liq suhbat quraolasiz. Bu yangi tanish bilan gaplashganda juda ishlatiladi: “Can you swim?”, “Can you cook?”.
scenes.say: Can Anna swim? Can you ride a bike? What can you cook?
scenes.say_uz: Anna suza oladimi? Velosiped haydashni bilasizmi? Nima pishira olasiz?

scenes.title: Qanchalik yaxshi: well
scenes.say_native: Qanchalik yaxshi qila olishimizni ham aytish mumkin. Eng yuqori daraja “very well”, undan keyin “well”, so‘ng “a little”, va nol daraja “not at all”. Birinchi uchtasi uchun “can”, oxirgisi uchun “can't ... at all”. Bu so‘zlar fe’ldan keyin keladi: “I can swim very well”. Diqqat: “well” ning ma’nosi “yaxshi”, lekin u ravish, ya’ni harakatning qanday bajarilishini aytadi.
scenes.say: Very well. Well. A little. Not at all. I can swim very well. I can't cook at all.
scenes.say_uz: Juda yaxshi. Yaxshi. Ozgina. Umuman yo‘q. Men juda yaxshi suzaman. Umuman ovqat pishira olmayman.

scenes.title: A little va little
board: I can speak a little English.
I can speak English a little.
I can speak little English.  (deyarli yo‘q)

examples.t: I can speak a little Russian.
I can play the guitar a little.

scenes.say_native: “A little” — ozgina, lekin baribir qila olaman. Uni ot oldiga ham, gap oxiriga ham qo‘ysa bo‘ladi: “I can speak a little English” yoki “I can speak English a little”. “A” ni tushirib qoldirmang. “Little” alohida bo‘lsa, ma’no o‘zgaradi: “I can speak little English” — deyarli bilmayman, ya’ni salbiy. Shuning uchun “a little” — ijobiy, “little” esa deyarli noldir.
scenes.say: A little means some, a bit. Little without a means almost none. I can speak a little English.
scenes.say_uz: A little - ozgina, biroz. A siz little - deyarli yo‘q. Men ozgina inglizcha gapira olaman.

scenes.title: I'm good at...
board: I'm good at cooking.  = I can cook well.
He's bad at singing.  = He can't sing well.
scenes.say_native: Can ning yaqin sinonimi bor: “be good at” va ing shakli. “I'm good at cooking” — men yaxshi pishiraman, “I can cook well” bilan deyarli bir xil. Teskarisi “bad at”: “He's bad at singing”. Bunda “at” dan keyin ing shakli keladi, oldingi darsda like bilan o‘rgangan qoidamizning o‘zi. O‘zbekchada “yaxshi uddalayman” kabi so‘z tarjimasi eng yaqin.
scenes.say: I'm good at cooking. He's bad at singing. After at, use the ing form.
scenes.say_uz: Men ovqat pishirishni yaxshi bilaman. U qo‘shiq aytishni yomon biladi. At dan keyin ing shakli keladi.

scenes.title: Good emas, well
board: ✓ I can swim well. I'm good at swimming.
scenes.say_native: Uch xato. Birinchisi: “I can swim good”. “Good” — sifat, u otni tasvirlaydi: “a good swimmer”. Harakat qanday bajarilishini aytish uchun “well” kerak. Ikkinchisi: “little” oldidan “a” ni tushirish, ma’no o‘zgarib ketadi. Uchinchisi: “good at swim”, “at” dan keyin ing shakli kerak, “swimming”. Ko‘pchilik o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar bu xatolarni so‘zma-so‘z tarjimadan qilishadi.
scenes.say: Not: I can swim good. Say: I can swim well. Say: a little. Say: good at swimming.
scenes.say_uz: I can swim good emas. I can swim well deng. A little deng. Good at swimming deng.

scenes.title: Darajani ayting
scenes.say_native: Lola haqida gapiring. Pianinoni juda yaxshi chaladi, shaxmatni o‘rtacha o‘ynaydi, mashinani juda ozgina haydaydi, chang‘i uchishni umuman bilmaydi. To‘rtta gap tuzing va “very well”, “well”, “a little”, “not at all” dan foydalaning. Birinchi: pianino. Ikkinchi: shaxmat. Uchinchi: mashina haydash. To‘rtinchi: chang‘i.
scenes.say: Talk about Lola. She plays the piano very well. She plays chess well. She drives a little. She cannot ski at all. Make four sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Lola haqida gapiring. U pianinoni juda yaxshi chaladi. Shaxmatni yaxshi o‘ynaydi. Ozgina mashina haydaydi. Chang‘i uchishni umuman bilmaydi. To‘rtta gap tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She can play the piano very well.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “She can play the piano very well.” “She can play chess well.” “She can drive a little.” “She can't ski at all.” Daraja so‘zlari fe’lning va ob’ektning orqasida turadi. “At all” faqat inkor gapda ishlatiladi: “I can't ski at all”, ijobiy gapda emas. Bu so‘z inkorni kuchaytiradi, ya’ni “umuman, zarracha”.
scenes.say: She can play the piano very well. She can play chess well. She can drive a little. She can't ski at all.
scenes.say_uz: U pianinoni juda yaxshi chala oladi. Shaxmatni yaxshi o‘ynay oladi. Ozgina mashina haydaydi. Chang‘i uchishni umuman bilmaydi.

scenes.title: Can: imkoniyat ma’nosi
scenes.say_native: Inglizchada “can” ikki ma’noda ishlatiladi. Birinchi, qobiliyat: “I can swim”, ya’ni biladi. Ikkinchi, imkoniyat: “I can't come today”, ya’ni bugun imkonim yo‘q. O‘zbekchada ikkalasi ham “-a olmoq” shaklida, rus tilida esa “уметь” va “мочь” ajratiladi. Inglizchada bir so‘z yetarli. Kontekst qaysi ma’noda ekanini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Can means ability and possibility. I can swim. I can't come today. Can you come at six?
scenes.say_uz: Can qobiliyat va imkoniyatni bildiradi. Men suza olaman. Bugun kela olmayman. Soat oltida kela olasizmi?

scenes.title: Can yoki can't?
scenes.say_native: Qiziq mashq. Bo‘sh joyga “can” yoki “can't” qo‘ying va butun gapni ayting. Birinchi: qush uchadi. Ikkinchi: baliq yurolmaydi. Uchinchi: chaqaloq mashina haydaydi. To‘rtinchi: mushuk daraxtga chiqadi. Mantiqan o‘ylang, keyin to‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang. Eslatma, hammasi umumiy haqiqatlar.
scenes.say: Choose can or can't. One: a bird, fly. Two: a fish, walk. Three: a baby, drive a car. Four: a cat, climb a tree.
scenes.say_uz: Can yoki can't ni tanlang. Bir: qush, uchmoq. Ikki: baliq, yurmoq. Uch: chaqaloq, mashina haydamoq. To‘rt: mushuk, daraxtga chiqmoq.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) A baby can't drive a car.
4) A cat can climb a tree.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “A bird can fly.” “A fish can't walk.” “A baby can't drive a car.” “A cat can climb a tree.” Ko‘rdingizmi, birlik ot bilan ham “can” o‘zgarmaydi. “A bird can” — “s” yo‘q. Bunday gaplar ingliz tilida boshlang‘ich darsliklarda juda ko‘p, chunki ular mantiqiy va esda qolarli.
scenes.say: A bird can fly. A fish can't walk. A baby can't drive a car. A cat can climb a tree.
scenes.say_uz: Qush uça oladi. Baliq yura olmaydi. Chaqaloq mashina haydamaydi. Mushuk daraxtga chiqa oladi.

scenes.title: Sport klubida
board: Aziz: Yes, I can. Very well.
Receptionist: Can you ride a horse?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog: Aziz sport klubiga yozilmoqda. Qabulxonadagi xodim undan nimalarni qila olishini so‘raydi. Diqqat bilan tinglang: Aziz suzishni qanchalik yaxshi biladi? Tennisni-chi? Otga minishni biladimi? Savollar dialogdan keyin keladi, shuning uchun hozir faqat tinglang.
scenes.say: Receptionist: Hello. Can you swim? Aziz: Yes, I can. I can swim very well. Receptionist: Can you play tennis? Aziz: I can play a little, but I can't play well. Receptionist: And can you ride a horse? Aziz: No, I can't.
scenes.say_uz: Xodim: Salom. Suza olasizmi? Aziz: Ha. Men juda yaxshi suzaman. Xodim: Tennis o‘ynay olasizmi? Aziz: Ozgina o‘ynay olaman, lekin yaxshi emas. Xodim: Otga mina olasizmi? Aziz: Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Aziz yaxshi suzadimi? Ikkinchi: u tennisni yaxshi o‘ynaydimi? Uchinchi: u otga mina oladimi? Qisqa javob berishdan tashqari, qanchalik yaxshi qila olishini ham ayting. Masalan, “Yes, he can. He can swim ...”.
scenes.say: One: can Aziz swim well? Two: can he play tennis well? Three: can he ride a horse?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Aziz yaxshi suzadimi? Ikki: tennisni yaxshi o‘ynaydimi? Uch: otga mina oladimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) No, he can't. He can play a little.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Yes, he can. He can swim very well”. Ikkinchi: yo‘q, yaxshi emas, ozgina: “No, he can't. He can play a little”. Uchinchi: “No, he can't”. Ko‘rib turibsiz, bitta savolga to‘liq javob berish uchun qisqa javobni va daraja so‘zini birlashtirish mumkin. Bu suhbatni tabiiy va qiziqarli qiladi.
scenes.say: Yes, he can. He can swim very well. No, he can't. He can play a little. No, he can't.
scenes.say_uz: Ha. U juda yaxshi suzadi. Yo‘q. U ozgina o‘ynay oladi. Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Yozgi lagerga ish
board: Maria: I can cook a little.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: Mariya yozgi lagerda ishlashni xohlaydi. Menejer undan nimalarni qila olishini so‘raydi. Tinglang: Mariya ovqatni qanchalik yaxshi pishiradi? U qaysi tilda ozgina gapira oladi? Mashina haydaydimi? Bu dialog ish suhbatiga o‘xshaydi, shuning uchun sizga kelajakda ham foydali.
scenes.say: Manager: Can you cook, Maria? Maria: I can cook a little. Manager: Can you speak English? Maria: Yes, I can speak English well. And I can speak a little German. Manager: Can you drive? Maria: No, I can't. But I can ride a bike.
scenes.say_uz: Menejer: Pishira olasizmi, Mariya? Mariya: Ozgina pishira olaman. Menejer: Inglizcha gapira olasizmi? Mariya: Ha, yaxshi gapira olaman. Ozgina nemischa ham. Menejer: Mashina haydaysizmi? Mariya: Yo‘q. Lekin velosiped haydayman.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) What language can she speak a little?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: Mariya yaxshi ovqat pishira oladimi? Ikkinchi: u qaysi tilda ozgina gapira oladi? Uchinchi: u mashina haydaydimi? Uchinchi savolga javobdan tashqari, u nimani qila olishini ham qo‘shing. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: One: can Maria cook well? Two: what language can she speak a little? Three: can she drive?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Mariya yaxshi pishira oladimi? Ikki: qaysi tilda ozgina gapiradi? Uch: mashina haydaydimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) No, she can cook a little.
3) No, she can't. She can ride a bike.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Mariya ovqatni yaxshi emas, ozgina pishiradi: “She can cook a little”. U ozgina nemischa gapiradi: “German”. Mashina hayday olmaydi: “No, she can't”, lekin velosiped hayday oladi: “She can ride a bike”. Dialogda menejer uchun muhim ma’lumot ishlatildi, ya’ni ingliz tilini yaxshi bilishi. Siz ham ish suhbatida shunday gapirasiz.
scenes.say: She can cook a little. German. No, she can't. She can ride a bike.
scenes.say_uz: U ozgina pishira oladi. Nemis tili. Yo‘q. U velosiped hayday oladi.

scenes.title: Iltimos qiling
scenes.say_native: Muloyim iltimos qiling. Birinchi: derazani ochishga ruxsat so‘rang. Ikkinchi: ruchkani qarzga olishga ruxsat so‘rang. Uchinchi: sumkaga yordam berishini so‘rang. Birinchi va ikkinchisida “Can I”, uchinchisida “Can you”. Oxirida “please” qo‘shsangiz, yanada muloyim bo‘ladi. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Ask politely. One: open the window. Two: borrow a pen. Three: ask for help with the bag.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim so‘rang. Bir: derazani ochish. Ikki: ruchka olish. Uch: sumkaga yordam so‘rash.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Can I open the window, please?
2) Can I borrow your pen, please?
3) Can you help me with my bag, please?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “Can I open the window, please?” “Can I borrow your pen, please?” “Can you help me with my bag, please?”. “Can I” bilan o‘zim uchun ruxsat so‘rayman, “Can you” bilan boshqadan yordam so‘rayman. Bu farqni yodda tuting. Javob sifatida “Sure”, “Of course” yoki “Sorry, I can't” deyishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: Can I open the window, please? Can I borrow your pen? Can you help me with my bag?
scenes.say_uz: Derazani ochsam bo‘ladimi? Ruchkangizni olsam bo‘ladimi? Sumkamga yordam bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Sizning navbatingiz
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz haqingizda ayting. Uchta qila oladigan ishingizni va uchta qila olmaydigan ishingizni ayting. Kamida bittasida “well” yoki “a little”, bittasida “at all” ni ishlating. Esda tuting: “can” dan keyin “to” yo‘q va “s” yo‘q, “can't” dan keyin ham oddiy fe’l keladi. Shoshilmang, har bir gapni aniq ayting.
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Say three things you can do and three things you can't do. Use well, a little or at all.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Qila oladigan uchta va qila olmaydigan uchta ishingizni ayting. Well, a little yoki at all ishlating.

scenes.title: Tekshirish ro‘yxati
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Birinchidan, “can” va “can't” dan keyin oddiy fe’l qo‘ydingizmi? Ikkinchidan, savolda “do” ishlatmadingizmi? Uchinchidan, “well”, “a little”, “not at all” kabi so‘zlarni to‘g‘ri joyga qo‘ydingizmi? To‘rtinchidan, “good” emas, “well” deganingizni tekshiring. Hammasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, siz hozir ingliz tilida o‘z imkoniyatlaringiz haqida tabiiy gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Check yourself. Did you use the simple verb after can? Did you avoid do? Did you say well, not good?
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Can dan keyin sodda fe’l ishlatdingizmi? Do dan qochdingizmi? Good emas, well dedingizmi?

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: very well / well / a little / not at all
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Birinchi, “can” va “can't” va ularning orqasida oddiy fe’l, hamma shaxsda bir xil. Ikkinchi, savol: “Can you swim?” va qisqa javob “Yes, I can”. Uchinchi, darajalar: “very well”, “well”, “a little”, “not at all”. To‘rtinchi, ko‘nikma so‘zlari. Beshinchi, “can” bilan talaffuz: yengil “can” va uzun “can't”. Endi qila olishingizni ingliz tilida erkin aytasiz.
scenes.say: Today we learned can and can't, questions with can, and well, a little and not at all.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun can va can't, can bilan savollar hamda well, a little va not at all ni o‘rgandik.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: use well / a little / at all
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: qila oladigan beshta ishingizni va qila olmaydigan beshta ishingizni ingliz tilida ayting yoki yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: hamma gapda “can” yoki “can't” dan keyin oddiy fe’l bo‘lsin, kamida ikkita gapda “well”, “a little” yoki “at all” ishlatilsin. Keyingi darsda sifatlar yordamida odam va narsalarni tasvirlashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: say or write five things you can do and five things you can't do.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: qila oladigan beshta va qila olmaydigan beshta ishingizni ayting yoki yozing.

homework_uz: Qila oladigan beshta ishingizni va qila olmaydigan beshta ishingizni ingliz tilida ayting yoki yozing. Hamma gapda can yoki can't dan keyin oddiy fe’l bo‘lsin va kamida ikkita gapda well, a little yoki at all ishlating.

quiz.why_uz: Can ga s qo‘shilmaydi va to kerak emas.
Inkor can't bilan tuziladi, do kerak emas.
Harakat qanday bajarilishini well ravishi aytadi.

quiz.q: 'I can speak a little English' means ...

quiz.why_uz: Speak English deymiz, in kerak emas.

quiz.q: He ___ drive a car. (He doesn't know how.)

quiz.why_uz: At dan keyin ing shakli keladi.

quiz.q: Which one is a polite request?
